resource.title: CS255: Introduction to Cryptography（Stanford，Dan Boneh；课程主页 + 完整 lecture 列表/slides + cs255 online 视频）
resource.covers: syllabus 逐讲讲：一次一密与流密码、语义安全、分组密码（AES、Even-Mansour、Luby-Rackoff）、PRP/PRF 与工作模式、CBC-MAC/PMAC、抗碰撞哈希（Merkle-Damgård、Davies-Meyer、SHA/HMAC）、公钥密码（ElGamal、RSA trapdoor）、数字签名定义与 RSA 签名、哈希签名与证书/证书透明/吊销、认证密钥交换与 SSL/TLS 会话建立，末尾还讲后量子签名与零知识证明入门——正好覆盖对称/公钥、哈希、MAC、签名、密钥管理（PKI/证书）与协议。

courses.prereq_text: Prerequisites: The course is self contained, however a basic understanding of probability theory and modular arithmetic will be helpful. The course is intended for advanced undergraduates and masters students. Students are expected to have experience with basic proof techniques and some programming experience.

The only formal prerequisite is a course on discrete mathematics (CS70). Specifically, we will assume familiarity with basic (discrete) probability and modular arithmetic. Students enrolled are also expected to have had some exposure to algorithms, mainly to be comfortable reading pseudocode and to be familiar with big-O notation.

extra_prereqs.evidence: UC Berkeley CS 171：唯一正式先修是 CS70（离散数学与概率论）
UC Berkeley CS 171 要求“some exposure to algorithms … familiar with big-O notation”
Stanford CS 255 只写“some programming experience”，属期望而非课程前置

notes: 两门课都没有把安全原理课列为先修（CS255 自称 self contained，CS171 只要求 CS70），故 S.1.1 判 not_mentioned。M.3.5/M.6.1 的 supported 依据：CS171 明确要求模算术与离散概率的熟悉度（CS70 覆盖），CS255 写“basic understanding of probability theory and modular arithmetic will be helpful”。Stanford CS255 的 overview.html 与 syllabus.html 均已打开核实；syllabus 中的“cs255 online”是配套视频网站。
